chronicConditions.name: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
chronicConditions.notes: HbA1c 9.2% at last check (Feb 2025). Peripheral neuropathy in both feet. Multiple hypoglycemic episodes in last 6 months due to inconsistent meals.

chronicConditions.name: Coronary Artery Disease
chronicConditions.notes: Triple-vessel disease. Post-CABG x3 (2017). LVEF 38% on last echo (Jan 2025). NYHA class II.

chronicConditions.name: Essential Hypertension
chronicConditions.notes: Generally well-controlled on current regimen. Home BP averages 132/80.

surgeries.procedure: Coronary Artery Bypass Graft x3 (LIMA-LAD, SVG-RCA, SVG-OM1)
surgeries.notes: Uncomplicated. Discharged POD 7. Cardiac rehab completed 2017.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Rina Wijaya, Cardiology — RS Jantung Harapan Kita
clinicalNotes.content: Patient seen for pre-Hajj cardiac clearance. Reports 2 episodes of exertional chest pain in last month, both relieved with SL nitro within 3 min. Stress test deferred — patient declined. Counseled extensively re: heat, exertion, hydration. Advised to carry nitro at all times and seek immediate help if chest pain >5 min.

clinicalNotes.author: Dr. Hadi Pramono, Endocrinology
clinicalNotes.content: HbA1c trending up (8.7 → 9.2). Patient admits skipping evening metformin 2-3x/week. Discussed adherence. No retinopathy on fundoscopy. Sensation reduced in bilateral toes — at risk for ulceration.
